en-US.name: Impeccable
en-US.summary: A design language that makes AI better at frontend: UX review, visual hierarchy, accessibility, typography, color, motion and reusable design systems. Uses an upstream standalone binary launcher that may download on first run; platform and execution permissions must be supplied separately.

zh-CN.name: Impeccable
zh-CN.summary: 让 AI 更懂设计的前端设计语言：覆盖 UX 审查、视觉层级、可访问性、排版、配色、动效与可复用设计系统，把界面打磨到生产级。新版本使用上游独立二进制启动器，可能在首次运行时下载；需自行满足平台与运行权限。

requirements.value: Impeccable 4.5.0 uses its standalone launcher/binary. The operator must permit the upstream binary to run and, if it is absent, authorize its first-run download. Windows uses the upstream .cmd launcher where sh is unavailable. DesireCore does not install or operate the binary.

A first-run binary download requires network access to upstream distribution. If the launcher is unavailable, follow the upstream documented direct-context fallback and report that the launcher did not run.
